title: Loi n° 23/CNT/2024 du 15 octobre 2024 portant protection de l'environnement
citation: Loi n° 23/CNT/2024 du 15 octobre 2024 portant protection de l'environnement (as named by UNEP LEAP; the Journal officiel copy was not read)
evidence: Opened https://leap.unep.org/en/countries/td/national-legislation/loi-ndeg-23cnt2024-du-15-octobre-2024-portant-protection-de on 2026-11-09 (UNEP LEAP tracker, not an official page): "Date of text 15 Oct 2024", "Repealed No", and the text "abroge toutes dispositions antérieures contraires, notamment, la Loi N°014/PR/1998 du 17 août 1998 définissant les principes généraux de la protection de l'environnement." No official page stating an in-force date was reached, so in_force is null.
notes: Environmental framework act (F2). Official text not read: the Chad gazette portal (journalofficiel.td, the only official publication route found) answered HTTP 403 to curl and a Cloudflare challenge to headless Chrome on 2026-11-09; https://www.cnt.td/index.php and the ministry and primature hosts did not connect. The official_url above is the portal, not a page for this instrument. Only the UNEP LEAP tracker was read, which gives the date of text (15 October 2024) and the repeal clause. A news report gives the plenary vote as 15 November 2024; the date is unresolved. Covered persons, duties and any climate or carbon provisions are not confirmed (the candidate climate and carbon content comes from a search summary only). The Loi n° 014/PR/98 of 17 August 1998 that it repeals is not in scope: no official copy was read.
status_note: No record stored: no official copy of the text was reachable and the licence row is not pass.
